matching_rule: Exactly one specification for every planned document ID in source-document-register.json; no extra IDs.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Child-safe professional case summary with restricted cover, child-first terminology, participants, age and proposed-charge states, short allegation summary, sourced chronology, participation/weapon issues, venue/remand/support state table and unresolved decisions. A separate child-facing explanation uses plain language without changing legal state.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 8-12 pages; professional narrative 280-480 words/page, chronology 8-18 sourced rows/page and child-facing pages 120-260 words with functional whitespace.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital accessible PDF planned from controlled source; tagged headings, readable tables, selectable text and a separately marked child-facing section; not a scan.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Short incomplete action fields and a revised chronology are legitimate when dated; child-facing phrasing may differ from professional wording but the underlying state and references remain identical.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Reporting-restricted child material. Y1 solicitor receives full served summary; Y1 gets age-appropriate own-case content; parent/carer receives authorised context only; court/CPS versions exclude unnecessary school/family detail.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No duplicated professional and child-facing narratives, repeated welfare boilerplate, generic youth-law extracts, decorative timelines or empty pages added for readability.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: Y2 conduct never attributed to Y1
reporting-restricted identifiers absent from inappropriate outputs

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Age and custody suite: certified/verified age records, custody record, rights and entitlements, appropriate-adult notification/attendance, solicitor contact/advice state, detention reviews, interview audio index/transcript and release/charge record. It proves safeguard timing and the designed no-confession negative control.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 24-32 pages; custody forms preserve authentic whitespace, event logs 10-24 entries/page and interview transcript 35-70 turns/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Mixed scanned custody forms and born-digital logs; native interview audio remains external with a timed transcript; handwritten entries may appear but must be legible or marked unreadable.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Ordinary corrections initialled/dated, delayed AA arrival, transcript inaudibles and one reconciled clock discrepancy are permitted. The source history remains; no invented breach or repaired timestamp.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Child health, family contacts and legal-advice content restricted. AA identity/contact minimised; privileged consultation excluded; client/court/CPS receive only authorised custody and interview material.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated rights text per page, invented custody events, duplicate transcript excerpts, blank form repetitions or padded detention logs.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: all clocks reconcile or conflict is explicit
AA and solicitor presence at interview visible
age source and event-age calculation agree
signatures/initials and page continuations are legible

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Witness section with statement covers, complainant and independent witness accounts, first-description records, identification-status notes, signature/declaration pages and later clarification history. It records accounts without deciding participation or identity.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 12-18 pages; 250-450 substantive words/page, first-description tables 8-16 entries/page and authentic sparse declaration pages allowed.
required_fields_headings_and_provenance: age and appropriate support where relevant
person allegedly described and confidence wording as actually recorded
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Signed scanned statements with typed or handwritten continuation pages; born-digital first-description comparison table; original document order and page identifiers preserved.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Natural uncertainty, inconsistent detail, spelling correction and a later clarification are preserved as separate versions; handwriting or scan shadow acceptable if content remains reviewable.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: All children reporting-restricted; addresses, school and family details redacted by audience. Cross-child statements served only where lawful/relevant; client output avoids unnecessary complainant personal detail.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated account summaries, fabricated certainty scales, duplicate declarations, generic witness guidance or empty continuation sheets.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: first and later descriptions remain distinct
witness words not rewritten as findings
no Y2 allegation becomes Y1 admission

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: CCTV evidence section with exhibit and camera register, acquisition/continuity statements, site map, native-file metadata, clip/still index, selected properly captioned stills, timing-offset analysis and quality limitations. It addresses presence and sequence, not intent.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 16-22 pages; camera register 8-18 rows/page, one site map/page and one to four necessary stills/page with readable captions; narrative 250-450 words/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Native CCTV remains external; born-digital register and map; stills retain aspect ratio and source-time labels. Ordinary compression, low light or occlusion may exist but are not artificially degraded.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Real camera-clock offset, occlusion, variable frame rate and a later corrected map annotation are allowed when documented; master files remain unchanged and derivatives versioned.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Child and bystander identities restricted; public/client extracts minimise unrelated faces and locations. Full-quality media accessible only to authorised teams/court subject to directions.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated near-identical stills, decorative maps, stretched images, invented enhancement, one-frame-per-page padding or unsupported facial labels.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: still labels resolve to native file/time
faces/redactions do not leak through layers
clip register totals and continuity reconcile

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Phone acquisition/extraction report and message schedule with device/account/person distinction, selection scope, chronological conversation tables, attachment references, deleted/missing-event notes and analyst limitations. It tests alleged planning without presuming agreement.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 14-20 pages; methodology 250-450 words/page and 10-24 meaningful message/call rows/page with compact but legible identifiers.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Native extraction external; searchable born-digital schedule; limited screenshots only as linked visual aids with authentic handset cropping/scaling.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Timezone correction, truncated preview, changed display name, missing attachment and later expanded selection allowed when logged and versioned.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Unrelated school, family and peer chats minimised. Y2/separate-matter content served only where relevant; child-client output uses necessary extracts and plain explanation.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated screenshot/schedule content, irrelevant chat sequences, one-message-per-page layouts, invented metadata or artificial emoji/image pages.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: display name not treated as verified author
messages not equated with intent without qualification

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Focused youth-justice material: school/local-authority request and scope, verified age/attendance and support extracts, YJS assessment sections, welfare/remand alternatives, family-context minimisation log and source/version index. It supports child-specific decisions, not offence proof.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 12-18 pages; structured assessments 200-420 words/page, tables 8-18 rows/page and authentic forms retain purposeful whitespace.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Mixed born-digital YJS forms/reports and focused scanned school/local-authority extracts; original institutional layout may vary, with an authoritative source index joining them.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Differing institutional terminology, incomplete attendance period, later corrected age entry and updated recommendation are preserved with author/date; uncertainty is legitimate.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Highly confidential child/family/education data. Only necessary extracts are included; parent/carer receives appropriate context but not legal-client or unrestricted evidential access; court/CPS/defence versions are purpose-limited.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No wholesale school file, repeated safeguarding boilerplate, generic developmental text, decorative assessment charts or irrelevant family history.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: remand alternative is not shown as order

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Effective-participation suite: referral/need record, specialist/intermediary assessment, materials considered, child communication profile, recommendations, application, responses, ground-rules agenda, court direction and implementation log. Each stage remains distinct.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 8-14 pages; assessment 250-450 words/page, recommendation/action tables 6-15 rows/page and court direction 150-350 words/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital assessment/application/direction planned, with signed scan only if authentic to origin; accessible headings and child-readable implementation sheet.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Provisional recommendation, changed need after reassessment, partial acceptance and a revised ground-rules plan are legitimate when dated; earlier versions retained.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Health/learning/family detail minimised. Full assessment limited to authorised professionals; child gets understandable participation arrangements; parent receives only authorised support information.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No generic disability descriptions, repeated recommendations, fabricated test scores, blank application forms or multiple cosmetic versions.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: confidential content absent from open/client-inappropriate exits
tables and form fields do not clip

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Court-language and procedural section: controlled Welsh notice, linked controlled English counterpart, issuer/version certificate, language-preference record, venue representations/decision, bail/remand material, reporting-restriction notice/order and service/action history.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 12-18 pages; notices/orders use authentic field density and whitespace, representations 250-450 words/page and procedural chronology 8-18 events/page. Welsh and English counterparts need not have identical pagination.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital controlled bilingual records; official-looking text is prohibited until qualified/HMCTS-style review. Each language remains a separate, accessible file with explicit counterpart relation, not overlaid machine text.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Natural pagination/line-break differences between languages, corrected hearing time and superseded notice are legitimate with issue history. No artificial mistranslation may be seeded.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Reporting-restricted child case. Notices distributed only to authorised recipients; address/contact and unrelated child data minimised. Welsh source and controlled English counterpart remain available to proper recipients.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No side-by-side repeated full text solely to add pages, no machine translation represented as official/certified, no duplicate notices without a real version event, no decorative Welsh language content.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: qualified Welsh-language review field remains blank until genuine review

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Child-specific trial/sentence and disclosure section: disclosure schedules/decisions, defence statement, YJS/pre-sentence materials, victim statement where authorised, sentence options/means/requirements, counsel extracts and hearing/outcome records. It keeps preparation, recommendation and judicial outcome separate.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 12-18 pages; schedules 10-22 rows/page, professional reports/advice 280-500 words/page and authentic sentence forms/orders may be sparse.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital schedules/reports with signed scanned defence or court documents where appropriate; stable row IDs and accessible headings; no native spreadsheet dependency.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Late disclosure item, amended defence statement, updated YJS recommendation and adjourned sentence are legitimate when versioned. Earlier positions remain auditable.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Sensitive schedules, child/family data and counsel advice are role-limited; privileged advice has zero CPS/court leakage; child receives comprehensible own-outcome material; parent receives authorised context only.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No generic sentencing essays, repeated background history, boilerplate schedule items, duplicate report summaries, invented references or blank outcome forms.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: no dismissed/unapproved charge drives sentence material
